text: {"lessons":["I sold A, D, and E after gains, but buying D back later reminds me not to trade on recent price moves alone; I should weigh each stock's outlook and my target allocation.","Selling C and B at losses shows that holding losing positions too long can hurt; I should reassess them consistently rather than wait for them to recover to my average cost.","My account value declined despite long stretches without trades, so I should review it periodically and make deliberate, balanced decisions instead of assuming inaction is safer."]}
